BiblicalUsage: Gimzo is a place in Palestine, named once in Scripture, in 2 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gimzo, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
